nominal_clock_rounding_note: Vivado can quantize nominal 150 MHz to 6.667 ns. After STA closure that period represents 149.9925 MHz, not exactly 150 MHz. The strict nominal target test is unchanged. Actual STA closure is reported separately even when quantization misses the nominal target; failed/incomplete STA yields no closed frequency.
